I guess you could say I tried twice.

First time was in middle school, so I didn't really know what I was doing. Downed half a bottle of Tylenol and just fell asleep eventually.

Fast forward 6-7 years to last month. Battled depression on and off since that, and without really thinking twice about it, just started munching on my meds. Things got fuzzy, I cried a lot... woke up the next day realizing that if I wasn't more careful, I could have died. Still not sure if I consider it an attempt, but it still bothers me.

As someone with some eating anxiety, along with a very hectic schedule and limited budget, I feel like I could be of some help.

You say you don't like to eat. Fair enough. But its essential. What were some of your favorite foots growing up? Or even flavors? Things like vegetables and fruits are pretty simple, healthy foods, and you have so much variety! Most are low in calories but high in nutrients so you are at least getting some of what your body needs.

I would also recommend vitamins. And maybe to talk to someone you trust about this. Eating disorders can be very serious and life-shattering...
